scope: RC-07 side-by-side staging with strict release-manifest tree equality
wrapper-performed sibling directory rename activation and rollback
injected staged-file corruption detection before activation
injected post-activation corruption with byte-identical rollback and no mixed versions
RC-08 uninstall with quarantine hosting and explicit retain/purge user-data policy
zero-residue audits with host-process-aware process snapshots
exact child exit-code recording for every phase and round
single delivery ZIP packaging the locked new candidate, the renamed previous-candidate copy, the lifecycle kit, a SHA-256 manifest and the operator prompt

packages.role: locked new candidate - name preserved because the harness stage binds basename
renamed byte copy of the previous candidate f24d9a4 - upgrade source proving a real version advance

design.activation_mechanism: Sibling directory renames performed by the cmd wrapper between harness phases; the harness always runs from an electron.exe inside a tree that must never be renamed while live
design.pre_upgrade_install: previous candidate f24d9a4 ZIP 909166478a8766ed380221d7b349e4db841651516be42feba7db281e0678f1d5 (archived read-only) so RC07-U01 proves a real version advance
design.extraction: Candidate zip nests one root directory; the harness extracts to a scratch sibling and renames the zip root into place as the staging directory
design.uninstall: preflight lock probe on the version file (electron.exe hosts the harness and cannot be renamed), quarantine rename, finalize applies retain/purge policy, wrapper removes quarantine and the transcript proves removal
design.process_snapshots: host-aware: the only permitted electron.exe is the harness process itself
design.registration_surface: none - no registry, service or PATH entries are created by the product
design.same_name_resolution: the new and previous candidates share the base filename, so the previous candidate is delivered as a renamed byte copy with an identical SHA-256; Windows can then distinguish the two without touching the locked new candidate filename
